plugins.name: vision-ocr
plugins.description: Vision OCR plugin for OpenClaude — extract text from images, PDFs, and URLs using RapidOCR (ONNX, CPU)

plugins.name: web-access
plugins.description: Web access for OpenClaude — web search, URL fetching, and GitHub search via local MCP server

plugins.name: markdown-preview
plugins.description: Markdown to PDF/HTML/PNG conversion via pandoc + LaTeX + DrissionPage. 3 MCP tools: markdown_to_pdf, markdown_to_html, markdown_to_png.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Context7 documentation lookup for any library/framework with API key rotation. 9 MCP tools: ctx7_resolve_library, ctx7_query_docs, ctx7_add_key, ctx7_remove_key, ctx7_list_keys, ctx7_set_strategy, ctx7_set_limit, ctx7_reset_stats, ctx7_current_key.

plugins.name: productivity-hooks
plugins.description: PostToolUse productivity hooks — output-distiller (collapse noisy command output) + adhd-mode (focus tracking). No MCP server.

plugins.name: documents-reader
plugins.description: Read PDF, DOCX, Excel, and TXT files. Extract text from documents for analysis and processing.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Persistent project memory via MEMORY.md. Store, search, and incrementally update project knowledge across sessions.

plugins.name: office-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for managing Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents (docx, xlsx, pptx) — 47 tools for read, write, edit, format, and export via LibreOffice.

plugins.name: codebase-memory
plugins.description: Codebase Memory — high-performance codebase knowledge graph MCP server (native binary v0.10.2, 158 languages). Index repos in milliseconds, sub-ms structural queries. Tools: index_repository, search_graph, trace_path, get_code_snippet, query_graph, get_architecture, index_status, list_projects, search_code, check_index_coverage.

plugins.name: scispace
plugins.description: SciSpace access for OpenClaude — headless Playwright MCP server for literature search on scispace.com using your logged-in (premium) session. 3 tools: search_papers, scispace_login, scispace_status.
